style.prompt: premium clean 2D preschool animation, soft cinematic lighting, rounded shapes, expressive friendly faces, polished educational cartoon, warm cheerful palette, strong foreground/background separation, one clear learning object per shot, uncluttered child-safe composition, no logos, no watermarks, no generated text
rules: Keep the same face, hairstyle, clothing colors, body proportions, and accessories for every recurring character.
Never redesign a recurring character between shots, scenes, or episodes.
Use one dominant learning object per shot and keep it large enough for a preschool child to recognize immediately.
Use simple backgrounds with strong subject separation and avoid decorative clutter.
Do not place text inside AI-generated keyframes; readable captions are composited after generation.

shot_rules.camera: stable medium or close shot with gentle motion only
shot_rules.continuity: same recurring cast identity and wardrobe across all shots

motion_rules: Every AI-video clip must contain visible subject or character motion.
Avoid one-second loops and repeated identical motion.
Prefer one clear action per shot: enter, point, react, reveal, count, choose, or celebrate.
Use a new composition when the learning object changes.
